Have you struggled with consistency, missed days, or felt suuuuper guilty when a planner just didn’t “stick”? Yeah, me too 🫶. Traditional planners don’t account for the way our ADHD brains think. They're built with 'productivity' and 'efficiency' at the centre, rather than helping us understand WHO we are and then working with our unique wiring. So I designed this planner to be flexible and forgiving, allowing you to use it as your brain needs. No more shame spirals and guilt. It evolves with you, supporting your creativity, motivation, and spontaneous nature without the pressure of "keeping up".

-------------------⌄-------------------

✨ Key Features ✨

⌂ Hyperlinked & Customizable: Choose from a fully hyperlinked daily planner or a build-your-own style. With over 260 templates, you can mix and match to fit your needs.

⌂ Dated Calendars: January-December calendars with Sunday or Monday start options.

⌂ ADHD-Friendly Tools: I’ve included tools like the Hyperfocus Lotus, Impulse Buy Checklist, and 10 & 10 · Savings Method—methods designed specifically for neurodivergent brains.

⌂ New templates for daily focus, self-care, chores, and more.

⌂ Enhanced features like the Daily Focus Friend (landscape), Cycle Tracker, and Chore Chopper.

⌂ Plus, exclusive access to our new Rewards Generator and the Future ADHD Planner Users Community.

-------------------⌄-------------------

🔧 Compatibility & Setup

The planner works with Apple, Android, and Windows annotation apps. I recommend using apps like GoodNotes, Notability, Xodo, Flexcil, and Noteshelf.

NOT COMPATIBLE WITH ONENOTE.
